subject: Re: Redwood pricing estimate & cost model — AxonLab (RWD-2457)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@axonlab.com>, Bill Turner <bill.turner@axonlab.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & preliminary cost model (post-call) — AxonLab

Hi Sofia / Bill —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps on pricing:

- Use case: AI-assisted clinical note summarization and search for internal R&D.
- Typical request size: avg prompt+response ~ 800 tokens (400 in, 400 out).
- Expected concurrency: spikes to ~60 qps for short periods, baseline steady-state ~10 qps.
- Volume: you indicated pilot ~50M tokens/month, with target scale to 500M tokens/month within 9–12 months.
- SLOs: 95th pct latency < 350ms for single-turn completions; streaming acceptable for longer responses.

Attached is a first-pass pricing workbook (redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx) with:
- Unit assumptions (tokens, sequence lengths, KV cache hit rates)
- Model variants (open-1.3B vs. open-7B) and recommended default for pilot
- Raw cost / token (compute + infra) and suggested list price / 1M tokens under a committed plan

High-level ask from your side: please confirm the pilot monthly token volume (50M) and whether the usage ramp to 500M in 9–12 months is realistic. Also please confirm your target budget range — you mentioned a ballpark of $1k–$5k/month for initial pilot in the call, which sounded like a placeholder; we should align on a target $/1M tokens so we can deliver an invoiceable estimate.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm pilot monthly tokens and target $/1M tokens (or budget range).
2) We adjust the attached workbook to show final invoice estimate (line items: model compute, infra fee, commitment discount, support).
3) Share a one-page statement of work + draft invoice for procurement review.

Attaching: redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx (first-pass), 1M_token_cost_breakdown.pdf (single-page unit economics snapshot).

Thanks — happy to walk through the workbook on a quick call if helpful.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@axonlab.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & preliminary cost model (post-call) — AxonLab

Thanks Marcus —

Quick confirmations from our side: pilot = 50M tokens/month (approx). Ramp plan: 50M -> 150M in month 3 -> 300M by month 6 -> 500M by month 12 if performance looks good.

Budget guidance: for pilot procurement we have ~ $6k/month available, but long-term budget for production (at 300–500M/mo) needs to be under $7k–$9k/month ideally — our finance team will push for $/1M tokens in the low-double digits.

Can you send the invoice-style estimate with a clear per-1M-token line and an example monthly invoice for 50M and 300M scenarios? Also we need a one-page justification for procurement showing monthly cost, SLA, and support level.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 30-min follow-up next week if you need clarifications.

— Sofia
Sofia Ramirez
Product Manager, AI
AxonLab
sofia.ramirez@axonlab.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@axonlab.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up & preliminary cost model (post-call) — AxonLab

Marcus / Aditya —

Looping you in with a suggested price cadence we can offer given the volumes Sofia confirmed. Key assumptions: pilot uses open-7B (recommended for quality/latency balance) with 75% KV cache hit (saves token decode cost), 1.25x multiplier for streaming/overhead.

Suggested committed pricing (list -> committed):
- List (on-demand): $28 / 1M tokens
- Committed 3mo (50M/mo): $18 / 1M tokens
- Committed 12mo (300M+/mo): $12 / 1M tokens

Example invoice calc (monthly):
- 50M tokens @ $18/1M = $900
- infra & support fee (fixed) = $2,500/month (includes 24/7 support & priority routing)
- Estimated total = $3,400/month (pilot)

- 300M tokens @ $12/1M = $3,600
- infra & support fee = $3,500/month (scale tier)
- Estimated total = $7,100/month (at-scale)

The attached workbook includes a per-token compute breakout, expected discounted unit economics, and a sample invoice line-item layout. If finance wants the invoice look-and-feel we can generate a PDF invoice for procurement.

Aditya — can you confirm margin impact and whether we can commit to the 12mo $12/1M level for 300M+? I can propose this to the customer pending internal approval.

— Marissa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@axonlab.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & preliminary cost model (post-call) — AxonLab

Thanks for the breakdown — quick finance check: margin and approval notes below.

- At $18/1M for 50M commitment we still maintain healthy gross margin (~45%) assuming open-7B serving on dedi pools with expected GPU utilization and KV cache assumptions in the workbook.
- At $12/1M for 300M+ (12mo) margin compresses but remains >30% which is acceptable for strategic expansion deals in this segment.
- Infra & support fees are negotiable; recommend keeping a minimum fixed fee (we should avoid < $2k/mo) to cover standby capacity and priority routing.

I'll prepare a final invoice mockup (PDF) and include the unit economics page (1M_token_cost_breakdown.pdf).

Aditya
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Invoice estimate & next steps — AxonLab (RWD-2457)

Sofia / Bill —

Thanks for the confirmations. Attached is the updated package:
- redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx (updated with committed tiers and exact invoice lines)
- 1M_token_cost_breakdown.pdf (unit economics snapshot you can share with finance)
- axonlab_usage_forecast.csv (your volume scenarios: 50M / 150M / 300M / 500M)

Quick summary (from workbook):
- Pilot (50M/mo): $18 / 1M tokens -> token charge = $900/month; infra & support = $2,500/month -> estimated invoice = $3,400/month
- Scale (300M/mo): $12 / 1M tokens -> token charge = $3,600/month; infra & support = $3,500/month -> estimated invoice = $7,100/month

Action items:
1) Please confirm you are ok with the pilot invoice estimate ($3,400/mo). If yes we will generate a one-page SOW + draft invoice for procurement.
2) If procurement needs a different contract cadence (quarterly/annual invoices) let us know — we can present both monthly and annualized views.
3) I can schedule a 30-min call to walk procurement through the one-pager and the unit economics PDF — available Thu/Fri this week.

If you sign off, we'll lock in the committed pricing and issue a draft invoice for review.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to procurement.

— Marcus
